title_en: Character Riddles (2/20): The Man Leaning on a Tree
note_en: The text ends with 再长的路，也要留时间休息 "however long the road, you have to leave time to rest." The pattern 再 + adjective ... 也 ... means "no matter how ...": 再长 "however long." English puts "however" or "no matter how" in front; Chinese marks the idea with 再 before the adjective and 也 in the following clause.
